messages.中指編成で嫉妬完全共鳴6を保ち、守備「ルール違反」の反撃を「怨念スタンピング」に: A Middle master that maintains 6 Envy Absolute Resonance in a Middle team, transforms Rule Violation's counter into Stamp of Vengeance while unlocking her sword, then crushes enemies with Lævateinn's exclusive skill.
messages.反撃からのS3(同期化Ⅳ): 戦闘開始時に嫉妬完全共鳴数の合計が6以上なら、「ル: **S3 from her counter (Uptie Ⅳ)**: If total Envy Absolute Resonance is 6 or more at Combat Start, she uses Stamp of Vengeance (Complete and Total Extermination [Lævateinn] during Lævateinn) when countering with Rule Violation (from the left-side slots of the dashboard, up to 2 times per turn). Triggering it through a counter grants 1 Blunt DMG Up next turn (once per turn). At Combat Start, Rule Violation also grants Shield equal to 30% of HP lost (15% at lower Uptie).
messages.剣の解放: 封印された剣と「熱を帯びてゆく娯しみ」1で始まる。娯しみは「怨念スタ: **Unsealing the sword**: She starts with Sealed Sword and 1 Rising Fever. Rising Fever decreases by 1 when she uses Stamp of Vengeance (including counters) or at the end of a turn with 6 or more Envy Absolute Resonance (once per turn). At 0, she makes a one-sided attack with Time to Unpack!, and the sword advances to the next stage (Rising Fever is 2 for First Seal Removed and Second Seal Removed). While the sword is sealed, it also triggers below 80% HP regardless of Rising Fever. In the unsealed stages, S2 and S3 also inflict Burn.
messages.中指-怨恨と刺青: バトルパッシブ「仕返し帳簿-蜘蛛の巣特別条項」(嫉妬×3・保: **The Middle - Grudge and Tattoos**: Through the combat passive Book of Vengeance - The House of Spiders Special Clause (3 Envy Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ), she gains 1 per Envy Resonance at Combat Start (up to 7). She also gains 2 when she is hit (twice per turn), 2 when Ishmael's The House of Spiders: The Middle Apprentice is hit (once per turn), and 1 when other Middle or House of Spiders allies are hit. After Stamp of Vengeance's attack, she spends all Grudge, gaining 1 The Middle - Vengeance Tattoo [Great Sister] per 5 spent (up to 10; +1 Final Power for basic skills per 5, and +5% damage for Envy and Blunt skills per point). With 15 or more Grudge, one basic skill in the lower row of her leftmost slot becomes Stamp of Vengeance or Complete and Total Extermination at Turn Start (3 times per battle).
messages.レーヴァテイン: 基本スキルが、全コイン破壊不能の専用スキルに替わる。ターン開始: **Lævateinn**: Her basic skills are replaced with dedicated skills that have all-Unbreakable Coins. At Turn Start, it inflicts 3 Burn on every character on the field. The dedicated skills give her Burn equal to their Coin count before attacking, and she loses 5 SP after attacking.
messages.耐久: この戦闘で最初に混乱したら、ターン終了時に解除して怨恨15を得る(強制混: **Durability**: The first time she is staggered in this battle, she recovers at Turn End and gains 15 Grudge (except forced Stagger). At 50% HP or less, she gains 3 Ridiculous Grit (once per battle).
messages.「娘ちゃん…ありがとよ。」(同期化Ⅲで取得): レーヴァテイン時、体力20%未満: **Thanks... Kiddo. (unlocked at Uptie Ⅲ)**: During Lævateinn, when an ally below 20% HP (below 30% for Ishmael's The Middle Apprentice) loses a Clash to an enemy, she uses a dedicated skill with that enemy as the main target and that ally as a sub-target (once per battle). Defeating a Middle ally grants 1 Envy DMG Up next turn, but defeating Ishmael's The House of Spiders: The Middle Apprentice grants Avenging My Family next turn instead. It interrupts before the enemy's skill is used, making it a trump card that can cancel an enemy skill at the cost of one ally.
messages.中指人格で嫉妬スキルを揃え、毎ターン嫉妬完全共鳴6を作るか「怨念スタンピング」を: Line up Envy skills with Middle Identities, and each turn either build 6 Envy Absolute Resonance or use Stamp of Vengeance to reduce Rising Fever and advance the unsealing. On turns with 6 Resonance, set up Rule Violation and fire Stamp of Vengeance from the counter, turning Grudge into Tattoos. Rising Fever only decreases by 1 per turn, so reaching Lævateinn takes 5 steps of progress in total. Deployed with Ishmael's The House of Spiders: The Middle Apprentice, Parenting lets them build buffs on each other through Clash Wins and hits (+1 Final Power for basic skills at 5 or more). Lævateinn's Burn also hits allies. In long fights, prepare a way to recover HP, and watch out for Middle allies being staggered and breaking the 6 Resonance.
